description: React component file defining error message components for admin console team and channel settings in Mattermost, including handling of user removal warnings and group/domain requirements.

methods.name: NeedGroupsError
methods.description: React component displaying an error message when no groups are added for team or channel management.

methods.name: NeedDomainsError
methods.description: React component displaying an error message when email domains are not specified.

methods.name: UsersWillBeRemovedError
